in_hindi.name: चरुदत्त
in_hindi.long_meaning: संतुष्ट (content, satisfied) + देने (to give) + वाला (one who)

in_marathi.name: Charudatt
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Joyful in giving
in_marathi.long_meaning: Charudatt हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Charu means 'joy' and Datt means 'giver'. This name is derived from the Sanskrit language and is often given to boys in Hindu culture.

in_bengali.name: Charudatt
in_bengali.meaning: হিন্দু নাম যার অর্থ Joyful in giving
in_bengali.long_meaning: Charudatt একটি হিন্দু নাম যা ভারতীয় সংস্কৃতিতে গভীর আধ্যাত্মিক তাৎপর্য রাখে। Charu means 'joy' and Datt means 'giver'. This name is derived from the Sanskrit language and is often given to boys in Hindu culture.
